description: Ministry of Health, Nutrition & Indigenous Medicine - Amendment to the Sri Lanka Medical Services Minute published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1883/13 of 11.10.2014 and that come into effect from 01.11.2013
reasoning: This gazette content pertains to public service recruitment and qualifications for medical administrative positions. It outlines the educational qualifications, selection procedures, and service requirements for appointments within the Sri Lanka Medical Service, specifically for the Senior Medical Administrative Grade. The notification is issued by the Public Services Commission, which deals with public sector administration, making it a clear example of Public Service Gazette content.
